Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott rules_inf Infrastructure rules_inf2.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Fixpoint erase_anno (e:exp) : dexp :=
  match e with
  | (e_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | e_top => de_top
  | (e_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => de_abs (erase_anno e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => de_fixpoint (erase_anno e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => de_app (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => de_merge (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => erase_anno e
  end.

Notation "| e |" := (erase_anno e) (at level 30, e at level 39).

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

Theorem reduction_soundness : forall e e',
    step e e' -> (erase_anno e) ->>* (erase_anno e').

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition i : Set := nat.

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | t_int : typ
 | t_top : typ
 | t_arrow (A:typ) (B:typ)
 | t_and (A:typ) (B:typ)  .

Inductive dexp : Set :=
 | de_var_b (_:nat)
 | de_var_f (x:var)
 | de_top : dexp
 | de_lit (i5:i)
 | de_abs (ee:dexp)
 | de_app (ee1:dexp) (ee2:dexp)
 | de_merge (ee1:dexp) (ee2:dexp)
 | de_fixpoint (ee:dexp)  .

Definition ctx : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Inductive st : Set :=
 | st_ty (A:typ).

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | e_var_b (_:nat)
 | e_var_f (x:var)
 | e_top : exp
 | e_lit (i5:i)
 | e_abs (A:typ) (e:exp) (B:typ)
 | e_fixpoint (e:exp) (A:typ)
 | e_app (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | e_merge (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | e_anno (e:exp) (A:typ)  .

Definition ls : Set := list st.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => e_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => e_5
        | inright _ => e_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | e_top => e_top
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => e_abs A (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e) B
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => e_fixpoint (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e) A
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => e_merge (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => e_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e) A
end.

Fixpoint open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (k:nat) (ee_5:dexp) (ee__6:dexp) {struct ee__6}: dexp :=
  match ee__6 with
  | (de_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => de_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => ee_5
        | inright _ => de_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (de_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | de_top => de_top
  | (de_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (de_abs ee) => de_abs (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => de_app (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => de_merge (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => de_fixpoint (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
end.

Definition open_exp_wrt_exp e_5 e__6 := open_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee_5 ee__6 := open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec 0 ee__6 ee_5.

Inductive lc_dexp : dexp -> Prop :=
 | lc_de_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_dexp (de_var_f x))
 | lc_de_top :
     (lc_dexp de_top)
 | lc_de_lit : forall (i5:i),
     (lc_dexp (de_lit i5))
 | lc_de_abs : forall (ee:dexp),
      ( forall x , lc_dexp  ( open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee (de_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_dexp (de_abs ee))
 | lc_de_app : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     (lc_dexp ee1) ->
     (lc_dexp ee2) ->
     (lc_dexp (de_app ee1 ee2))
 | lc_de_merge : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     (lc_dexp ee1) ->
     (lc_dexp ee2) ->
     (lc_dexp (de_merge ee1 ee2))
 | lc_de_fixpoint : forall (ee:dexp),
      ( forall x , lc_dexp  ( open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee (de_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_dexp (de_fixpoint ee)).

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_e_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_exp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_top :
     (lc_exp e_top)
 | lc_e_lit : forall (i5:i),
     (lc_exp (e_lit i5))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (B:typ),
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_abs A e B))
 | lc_e_fixpoint : forall (e:exp) (A:typ),
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_fixpoint e A))
 | lc_e_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_app e1 e2))
 | lc_e_merge : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_merge e1 e2))
 | lc_e_anno : forall (e:exp) (A:typ),
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (e_anno e A)).

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {{x}}
  | e_top => {}
  | (e_lit i5) => {}
  | (e_abs A e B) => (fv_exp e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => (fv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (fv_exp e1) \u (fv_exp e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => (fv_exp e1) \u (fv_exp e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => (fv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint fv_dexp (ee_5:dexp) : vars :=
  match ee_5 with
  | (de_var_b nat) => {}
  | (de_var_f x) => {{x}}
  | de_top => {}
  | (de_lit i5) => {}
  | (de_abs ee) => (fv_dexp ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => (fv_dexp ee1) \u (fv_dexp ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => (fv_dexp ee1) \u (fv_dexp ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => (fv_dexp ee)
end.

Fixpoint subst_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:var) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then e_5 else (e_var_f x))
  | e_top => e_top
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => e_abs A (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) B
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => e_fixpoint (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) A
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => e_merge (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => e_anno (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) A
end.

Fixpoint subst_dexp (ee_5:dexp) (x5:var) (ee__6:dexp) {struct ee__6} : dexp :=
  match ee__6 with
  | (de_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (de_var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then ee_5 else (de_var_f x))
  | de_top => de_top
  | (de_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (de_abs ee) => de_abs (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => de_app (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee1) (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => de_merge (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee1) (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => de_fixpoint (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee)
end.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | value_unit :
     value e_top
 | value_lit : forall (i5:i),
     value (e_lit i5)
 | value_anno : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (B:typ),
     lc_exp (e_abs A e B) ->
     value (e_abs A e B)
 | value_merge : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     value (e_merge v1 v2).

Inductive topLike : typ -> Prop :=
 | TL_top :
     topLike t_top
 | TL_and : forall (A B:typ),
     topLike A ->
     topLike B ->
     topLike (t_and A B)
 | TL_arr : forall (A B:typ),
     topLike B ->
     topLike (t_arrow A B).

Inductive ord : typ -> Prop :=
 | O_top :
     ord t_top
 | O_int :
     ord t_int
 | O_arrow : forall (A B:typ),
     ord (t_arrow A B).

Inductive disjoint : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | D_topL : forall (A:typ),
     disjoint t_top A
 | D_topR : forall (A:typ),
     disjoint A t_top
 | D_andL : forall (A1 A2 B:typ),
     disjoint A1 B ->
     disjoint A2 B ->
     disjoint (t_and A1 A2) B
 | D_andR : forall (A B1 B2:typ),
     disjoint A B1 ->
     disjoint A B2 ->
     disjoint A (t_and B1 B2)
 | D_IntArr : forall (A1 A2:typ),
     disjoint t_int (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | D_ArrInt : forall (A1 A2:typ),
     disjoint (t_arrow A1 A2) t_int
 | D_ArrArr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     disjoint A2 B2 ->
     disjoint (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2).

Inductive sub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | S_z :
     sub t_int t_int
 | S_top : forall (A:typ),
     sub A t_top
 | S_toparr : forall (A B1 B2:typ),
     sub t_top B2 ->
     sub A (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | S_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     sub B1 A1 ->
     sub A2 B2 ->
     sub (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | S_andl1 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     sub A1 A3 ->
     sub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | S_andl2 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     sub A2 A3 ->
     sub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | S_andr : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     sub A1 A2 ->
     sub A1 A3 ->
     sub A1 (t_and A2 A3).

Inductive TypedReduce : exp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
 | TReduce_lit : forall (i5:i),
     TypedReduce (e_lit i5) t_int (e_lit i5)
 | TReduce_top : forall (v:exp),
     lc_exp v ->
     TypedReduce v t_top e_top
 | TReduce_toparr : forall (v:exp) (A B:typ),
     lc_exp v ->
     topLike B ->
     TypedReduce v (t_arrow A B) (e_abs t_top e_top B)
 | TReduce_arrow : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (B C D:typ),
     lc_exp (e_abs A e B) ->
      not ( topLike D )  ->
     sub C A ->
     sub B D ->
     TypedReduce (e_abs A e B)  (t_arrow C D)  (e_abs A e D)
 | TReduce_mergevl : forall (v1 v2:exp) (A:typ) (v1':exp),
     lc_exp v2 ->
     TypedReduce v1 A v1' ->
     ord A ->
     TypedReduce (e_merge v1 v2) A v1'
 | TReduce_mergevr : forall (v1 v2:exp) (A:typ) (v2':exp),
     lc_exp v1 ->
     TypedReduce v2 A v2' ->
     ord A ->
     TypedReduce (e_merge v1 v2) A v2'
 | TReduce_and : forall (v:exp) (A B:typ) (v1 v2:exp),
     TypedReduce v A v1 ->
     TypedReduce v B v2 ->
     TypedReduce v (t_and A B) (e_merge v1 v2)
with step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | Step_beta : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (D:typ) (v v':exp),
     lc_exp (e_abs A e D) ->
     value v ->
     TypedReduce v A v' ->
     step (e_app  ( (e_abs A e D) )  v) (e_anno  (  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e v' )  )  D)
 | Step_annov : forall (v:exp) (A:typ) (v':exp),
     value v ->
     TypedReduce v A v' ->
     step (e_anno v A) v'
 | Step_appl : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (e_app e1 e2) (e_app e1' e2)
 | Step_appr : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (e_app v1 e2) (e_app v1 e2')
 | Step_mergel : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (e_merge e1 e2) (e_merge e1' e2)
 | Step_merger : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (e_merge v1 e2) (e_merge v1 e2')
 | Step_anno : forall (e:exp) (A:typ) (e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (e_anno e A) (e_anno e' A)
 | Step_fix : forall (e:exp) (A:typ),
     lc_exp (e_fixpoint e A) ->
     step (e_fixpoint e A)  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e (e_fixpoint e A) ) .

Definition disjointSpec A B :=
  forall C, sub A C -> sub B C -> topLike C.

Definition consistencySpec v1 v2 :=
  forall A v1' v2', TypedReduce v1 A v1' -> TypedReduce v2 A v2' -> v1' = v2'.

Inductive Etyping : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | Etyp_top : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     Etyping G e_top t_top
 | Etyp_lit : forall (G:ctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  G  ->
     Etyping G (e_lit i5) t_int
 | Etyp_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (A:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     Etyping G (e_var_f x) A
 | Etyp_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A:typ) (e:exp) (D C B:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Etyping  (cons ( x , A )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  B )  ->
     sub C A ->
     sub B D ->
     Etyping G  ( (e_abs A e D) )  (t_arrow C D)
 | Etyp_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (B A:typ),
     Etyping G e2 A ->
     Etyping G e1 (t_arrow A B) ->
     Etyping G (e_app e1 e2) B
 | Etyp_merge : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A B:typ),
     Etyping G e1 A ->
     Etyping G e2 B ->
      disjointSpec A B  ->
     Etyping G (e_merge e1 e2) (t_and A B)
 | Etyp_anno : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (A B:typ),
     Etyping G e B ->
     sub B A ->
     Etyping G  ( (e_anno e A) )  A
 | Etyp_fix : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (e:exp) (A:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Etyping  (cons ( x , A )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A )  ->
     Etyping G  ( (e_fixpoint e A) )  A
 | Etyp_mergev : forall (G:ctx) (v1 v2:exp) (A B:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
     value (e_merge v1 v2) ->
     Etyping  nil  v1 A ->
     Etyping  nil  v2 B ->
      consistencySpec v1 v2  ->
     Etyping G (e_merge v1 v2) (t_and A B).

Inductive DValue : dexp -> Prop :=
 | DVal_var : forall (x:var),
     DValue (de_var_f x)
 | DVal_top :
     DValue de_top
 | DVal_nat : forall (i5:i),
     DValue (de_lit i5)
 | DVal_abs : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp (de_abs ee) ->
     DValue (de_abs ee)
 | DVal_merge : forall (vv1 vv2:dexp),
     DValue vv1 ->
     DValue vv2 ->
     DValue (de_merge vv1 vv2).

Inductive DunfieldStep : dexp -> dexp -> Prop :=
 | DStep_appl : forall (ee1 ee2 ee1':dexp),
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     DunfieldStep ee1 ee1' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_app ee1 ee2) (de_app ee1' ee2)
 | DStep_appr : forall (vv1 ee2 ee2':dexp),
     DValue vv1 ->
     DunfieldStep ee2 ee2' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_app vv1 ee2) (de_app vv1 ee2')
 | DStep_beta : forall (ee vv:dexp),
     lc_dexp (de_abs ee) ->
     DValue vv ->
     DunfieldStep (de_app  ( (de_abs ee) )  vv)  (  (open_dexp_wrt_dexp  ee vv )  )
 | DStep_fix : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp (de_fixpoint ee) ->
     DunfieldStep (de_fixpoint ee)  (open_dexp_wrt_dexp  ee (de_fixpoint ee) )
 | DStep_unmergel : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     lc_dexp ee1 ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge ee1 ee2) ee1
 | DStep_unmerger : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee1 ->
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge ee1 ee2) ee2
 | DStep_mergel : forall (ee1 ee2 ee1':dexp),
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     DunfieldStep ee1 ee1' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge ee1 ee2) (de_merge ee1' ee2)
 | DStep_merger : forall (vv1 ee2 ee2':dexp),
     DValue vv1 ->
     DunfieldStep ee2 ee2' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge vv1 ee2) (de_merge vv1 ee2')
 | DStep_split : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee ->
     DunfieldStep ee (de_merge ee ee)
 | DStep_top : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee ->
     DunfieldStep ee de_top
 | DStep_toparr :
     DunfieldStep de_top (de_abs de_top).

Inductive icfpDisjoint : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | ID_andL : forall (A1 A2 B:typ),
     icfpDisjoint A1 B ->
     icfpDisjoint A2 B ->
     icfpDisjoint (t_and A1 A2) B
 | ID_andR : forall (A B1 B2:typ),
     icfpDisjoint A B1 ->
     icfpDisjoint A B2 ->
     icfpDisjoint A (t_and B1 B2)
 | ID_ArrArr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     icfpDisjoint A2 B2 ->
     icfpDisjoint (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | ID_Ax : forall (A B:typ),
     icfpDisjointAx A B ->
     icfpDisjoint A B
with icfpDisjointAx : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | IDax_IntArr : forall (A B:typ),
      not ( topLike B )  ->
     icfpDisjointAx t_int (t_arrow A B)
 | IDax_symm : forall (B A:typ),
     icfpDisjointAx A B ->
     icfpDisjointAx B A.

Inductive WF : ctx -> typ -> Prop :=
 | Wf_int : forall (G:ctx),
     WF G t_int
 | Wf_top : forall (G:ctx),
     WF G t_top
 | Wf_arr : forall (G:ctx) (A B:typ),
     WF G A ->
     WF G B ->
     WF G (t_arrow A B)
 | Wf_and : forall (G:ctx) (A B:typ),
     WF G A ->
     WF G B ->
     icfpDisjoint A B ->
     WF G (t_and A B).

Inductive isub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | IS_z :
     isub t_int t_int
 | IS_top : forall (A:typ),
     isub A t_top
 | IS_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     isub B1 A1 ->
     isub A2 B2 ->
     isub (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | IS_andl1 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     isub A1 A3 ->
     isub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | IS_andl2 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     isub A2 A3 ->
     isub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | IS_andr : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     isub A1 A2 ->
     isub A1 A3 ->
     isub A1 (t_and A2 A3).

Inductive ITyping : ctx -> dexp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
 | ITyp_top : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     ITyping G de_top t_top e_top
 | ITyp_lit : forall (G:ctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  G  ->
     ITyping G (de_lit i5) t_int (e_lit i5)
 | ITyp_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (A:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     ITyping G (de_var_f x) A (e_var_f x)
 | ITyp_lam : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (ee:dexp) (A B:typ) (e:exp),
     WF G A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> ITyping  (cons ( x , A )  G )   ( open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee (de_var_f x) )  B  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     ITyping G  ( (de_abs ee) )  (t_arrow A B)  ( (e_abs A e B) )
 | ITyp_app : forall (G:ctx) (ee1 ee2:dexp) (B:typ) (e1 e2:exp) (A:typ),
     ITyping G ee1 (t_arrow A B) e1 ->
     ITyping G ee2 A e2 ->
     ITyping G (de_app ee1 ee2) B (e_app e1 e2)
 | ITyp_merge : forall (G:ctx) (ee1 ee2:dexp) (A B:typ) (e1 e2:exp),
     ITyping G ee1 A e1 ->
     ITyping G ee2 B e2 ->
     icfpDisjoint A B ->
     ITyping G (de_merge ee1 ee2) (t_and A B) (e_merge e1 e2)

     ITyping G ee A e ->
     isub A B ->
     ITyping G ee B (e_anno e B).

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Definition i : Set := nat.

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | t_int : typ
 | t_top : typ
 | t_arrow (A:typ) (B:typ)
 | t_and (A:typ) (B:typ)  .

Inductive dexp : Set :=
 | de_var_b (_:nat)
 | de_var_f (x:var)
 | de_top : dexp
 | de_lit (i5:i)
 | de_abs (ee:dexp)
 | de_app (ee1:dexp) (ee2:dexp)
 | de_merge (ee1:dexp) (ee2:dexp)
 | de_fixpoint (ee:dexp)  .

Definition ctx : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Inductive st : Set :=
 | st_ty (A:typ).

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | e_var_b (_:nat)
 | e_var_f (x:var)
 | e_top : exp
 | e_lit (i5:i)
 | e_abs (A:typ) (e:exp) (B:typ)
 | e_fixpoint (e:exp) (A:typ)
 | e_app (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | e_merge (e1:exp) (e2:exp)
 | e_anno (e:exp) (A:typ)  .

Definition ls : Set := list st.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => e_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => e_5
        | inright _ => e_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | e_top => e_top
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => e_abs A (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e) B
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => e_fixpoint (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e) A
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => e_merge (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => e_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e) A
end.

Fixpoint open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (k:nat) (ee_5:dexp) (ee__6:dexp) {struct ee__6}: dexp :=
  match ee__6 with
  | (de_var_b nat) =>
      match lt_eq_lt_dec nat k with
        | inleft (left _) => de_var_b nat
        | inleft (right _) => ee_5
        | inright _ => de_var_b (nat - 1)
      end
  | (de_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | de_top => de_top
  | (de_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (de_abs ee) => de_abs (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => de_app (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => de_merge (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee1) (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k ee_5 ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => de_fixpoint (open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec (S k) ee_5 ee)
end.

Definition open_exp_wrt_exp e_5 e__6 := open_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Definition open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee_5 ee__6 := open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec 0 ee__6 ee_5.

Inductive lc_dexp : dexp -> Prop :=
 | lc_de_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_dexp (de_var_f x))
 | lc_de_top :
     (lc_dexp de_top)
 | lc_de_lit : forall (i5:i),
     (lc_dexp (de_lit i5))
 | lc_de_abs : forall (ee:dexp),
      ( forall x , lc_dexp  ( open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee (de_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_dexp (de_abs ee))
 | lc_de_app : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     (lc_dexp ee1) ->
     (lc_dexp ee2) ->
     (lc_dexp (de_app ee1 ee2))
 | lc_de_merge : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     (lc_dexp ee1) ->
     (lc_dexp ee2) ->
     (lc_dexp (de_merge ee1 ee2))
 | lc_de_fixpoint : forall (ee:dexp),
      ( forall x , lc_dexp  ( open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee (de_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_dexp (de_fixpoint ee)).

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_e_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_exp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_top :
     (lc_exp e_top)
 | lc_e_lit : forall (i5:i),
     (lc_exp (e_lit i5))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (B:typ),
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_abs A e B))
 | lc_e_fixpoint : forall (e:exp) (A:typ),
      ( forall x , lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_fixpoint e A))
 | lc_e_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_app e1 e2))
 | lc_e_merge : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_merge e1 e2))
 | lc_e_anno : forall (e:exp) (A:typ),
     (lc_exp e) ->
     (lc_exp (e_anno e A)).

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => {}
  | (e_var_f x) => {{x}}
  | e_top => {}
  | (e_lit i5) => {}
  | (e_abs A e B) => (fv_exp e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => (fv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (fv_exp e1) \u (fv_exp e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => (fv_exp e1) \u (fv_exp e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => (fv_exp e)
end.

Fixpoint fv_dexp (ee_5:dexp) : vars :=
  match ee_5 with
  | (de_var_b nat) => {}
  | (de_var_f x) => {{x}}
  | de_top => {}
  | (de_lit i5) => {}
  | (de_abs ee) => (fv_dexp ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => (fv_dexp ee1) \u (fv_dexp ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => (fv_dexp ee1) \u (fv_dexp ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => (fv_dexp ee)
end.

Fixpoint subst_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:var) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then e_5 else (e_var_f x))
  | e_top => e_top
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => e_abs A (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) B
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => e_fixpoint (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) A
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => e_merge (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => e_anno (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) A
end.

Fixpoint subst_dexp (ee_5:dexp) (x5:var) (ee__6:dexp) {struct ee__6} : dexp :=
  match ee__6 with
  | (de_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (de_var_f x) => (if eq_var x x5 then ee_5 else (de_var_f x))
  | de_top => de_top
  | (de_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (de_abs ee) => de_abs (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee)
  | (de_app ee1 ee2) => de_app (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee1) (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee2)
  | (de_merge ee1 ee2) => de_merge (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee1) (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee2)
  | (de_fixpoint ee) => de_fixpoint (subst_dexp ee_5 x5 ee)
end.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | value_unit :
     value e_top
 | value_lit : forall (i5:i),
     value (e_lit i5)
 | value_anno : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (B:typ),
     lc_exp (e_abs A e B) ->
     value (e_abs A e B)
 | value_merge : forall (v1 v2:exp),
     value v1 ->
     value v2 ->
     value (e_merge v1 v2).

Inductive topLike : typ -> Prop :=
 | TL_top :
     topLike t_top
 | TL_and : forall (A B:typ),
     topLike A ->
     topLike B ->
     topLike (t_and A B)
 | TL_arr : forall (A B:typ),
     topLike B ->
     topLike (t_arrow A B).

Inductive ord : typ -> Prop :=
 | O_top :
     ord t_top
 | O_int :
     ord t_int
 | O_arrow : forall (A B:typ),
     ord (t_arrow A B).

Inductive disjoint : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | D_topL : forall (A:typ),
     disjoint t_top A
 | D_topR : forall (A:typ),
     disjoint A t_top
 | D_andL : forall (A1 A2 B:typ),
     disjoint A1 B ->
     disjoint A2 B ->
     disjoint (t_and A1 A2) B
 | D_andR : forall (A B1 B2:typ),
     disjoint A B1 ->
     disjoint A B2 ->
     disjoint A (t_and B1 B2)
 | D_IntArr : forall (A1 A2:typ),
     disjoint t_int (t_arrow A1 A2)
 | D_ArrInt : forall (A1 A2:typ),
     disjoint (t_arrow A1 A2) t_int
 | D_ArrArr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     disjoint A2 B2 ->
     disjoint (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2).

Inductive sub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | S_z :
     sub t_int t_int
 | S_top : forall (A:typ),
     sub A t_top
 | S_toparr : forall (A B1 B2:typ),
     sub t_top B2 ->
     sub A (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | S_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     sub B1 A1 ->
     sub A2 B2 ->
     sub (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | S_andl1 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     sub A1 A3 ->
     sub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | S_andl2 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     sub A2 A3 ->
     sub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | S_andr : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     sub A1 A2 ->
     sub A1 A3 ->
     sub A1 (t_and A2 A3).

Inductive TypedReduce : exp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
 | TReduce_lit : forall (i5:i),
     TypedReduce (e_lit i5) t_int (e_lit i5)
 | TReduce_top : forall (v:exp),
     lc_exp v ->
     TypedReduce v t_top e_top
 | TReduce_toparr : forall (v:exp) (A B:typ),
     lc_exp v ->
     topLike B ->
     TypedReduce v (t_arrow A B) (e_abs t_top e_top B)
 | TReduce_arrow : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (B C D:typ),
     lc_exp (e_abs A e B) ->
      not ( topLike D )  ->
     sub C A ->
     sub B D ->
     TypedReduce (e_abs A e B)  (t_arrow C D)  (e_abs A e D)
 | TReduce_mergevl : forall (v1 v2:exp) (A:typ) (v1':exp),
     lc_exp v2 ->
     TypedReduce v1 A v1' ->
     ord A ->
     TypedReduce (e_merge v1 v2) A v1'
 | TReduce_mergevr : forall (v1 v2:exp) (A:typ) (v2':exp),
     lc_exp v1 ->
     TypedReduce v2 A v2' ->
     ord A ->
     TypedReduce (e_merge v1 v2) A v2'
 | TReduce_and : forall (v:exp) (A B:typ) (v1 v2:exp),
     TypedReduce v A v1 ->
     TypedReduce v B v2 ->
     TypedReduce v (t_and A B) (e_merge v1 v2)
with step : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | Step_beta : forall (A:typ) (e:exp) (D:typ) (v v':exp),
     lc_exp (e_abs A e D) ->
     value v ->
     TypedReduce v A v' ->
     step (e_app  ( (e_abs A e D) )  v) (e_anno  (  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e v' )  )  D)
 | Step_annov : forall (v:exp) (A:typ) (v':exp),
     value v ->
     TypedReduce v A v' ->
     step (e_anno v A) v'
 | Step_appl : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (e_app e1 e2) (e_app e1' e2)
 | Step_appr : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (e_app v1 e2) (e_app v1 e2')
 | Step_mergel : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     step e1 e1' ->
     step (e_merge e1 e2) (e_merge e1' e2)
 | Step_merger : forall (v1 e2 e2':exp),
     value v1 ->
     step e2 e2' ->
     step (e_merge v1 e2) (e_merge v1 e2')
 | Step_anno : forall (e:exp) (A:typ) (e':exp),
     step e e' ->
     step (e_anno e A) (e_anno e' A)
 | Step_fix : forall (e:exp) (A:typ),
     lc_exp (e_fixpoint e A) ->
     step (e_fixpoint e A)  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e (e_fixpoint e A) ) .

Definition disjointSpec A B :=
  forall C, sub A C -> sub B C -> topLike C.

Definition consistencySpec v1 v2 :=
  forall A v1' v2', TypedReduce v1 A v1' -> TypedReduce v2 A v2' -> v1' = v2'.

Inductive Etyping : ctx -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | Etyp_top : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     Etyping G e_top t_top
 | Etyp_lit : forall (G:ctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  G  ->
     Etyping G (e_lit i5) t_int
 | Etyp_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (A:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     Etyping G (e_var_f x) A
 | Etyp_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (A:typ) (e:exp) (D C B:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Etyping  (cons ( x , A )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  B )  ->
     sub C A ->
     sub B D ->
     Etyping G  ( (e_abs A e D) )  (t_arrow C D)
 | Etyp_app : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (B A:typ),
     Etyping G e2 A ->
     Etyping G e1 (t_arrow A B) ->
     Etyping G (e_app e1 e2) B
 | Etyp_merge : forall (G:ctx) (e1 e2:exp) (A B:typ),
     Etyping G e1 A ->
     Etyping G e2 B ->
      disjointSpec A B  ->
     Etyping G (e_merge e1 e2) (t_and A B)
 | Etyp_anno : forall (G:ctx) (e:exp) (A B:typ),
     Etyping G e B ->
     sub B A ->
     Etyping G  ( (e_anno e A) )  A
 | Etyp_fix : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (e:exp) (A:typ),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> Etyping  (cons ( x , A )  G )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  A )  ->
     Etyping G  ( (e_fixpoint e A) )  A
 | Etyp_mergev : forall (G:ctx) (v1 v2:exp) (A B:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
     value (e_merge v1 v2) ->
     Etyping  nil  v1 A ->
     Etyping  nil  v2 B ->
      consistencySpec v1 v2  ->
     Etyping G (e_merge v1 v2) (t_and A B).

Inductive DValue : dexp -> Prop :=
 | DVal_var : forall (x:var),
     DValue (de_var_f x)
 | DVal_top :
     DValue de_top
 | DVal_nat : forall (i5:i),
     DValue (de_lit i5)
 | DVal_abs : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp (de_abs ee) ->
     DValue (de_abs ee)
 | DVal_merge : forall (vv1 vv2:dexp),
     DValue vv1 ->
     DValue vv2 ->
     DValue (de_merge vv1 vv2).

Inductive DunfieldStep : dexp -> dexp -> Prop :=
 | DStep_appl : forall (ee1 ee2 ee1':dexp),
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     DunfieldStep ee1 ee1' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_app ee1 ee2) (de_app ee1' ee2)
 | DStep_appr : forall (vv1 ee2 ee2':dexp),
     DValue vv1 ->
     DunfieldStep ee2 ee2' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_app vv1 ee2) (de_app vv1 ee2')
 | DStep_beta : forall (ee vv:dexp),
     lc_dexp (de_abs ee) ->
     DValue vv ->
     DunfieldStep (de_app  ( (de_abs ee) )  vv)  (  (open_dexp_wrt_dexp  ee vv )  )
 | DStep_fix : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp (de_fixpoint ee) ->
     DunfieldStep (de_fixpoint ee)  (open_dexp_wrt_dexp  ee (de_fixpoint ee) )
 | DStep_unmergel : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     lc_dexp ee1 ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge ee1 ee2) ee1
 | DStep_unmerger : forall (ee1 ee2:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee1 ->
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge ee1 ee2) ee2
 | DStep_mergel : forall (ee1 ee2 ee1':dexp),
     lc_dexp ee2 ->
     DunfieldStep ee1 ee1' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge ee1 ee2) (de_merge ee1' ee2)
 | DStep_merger : forall (vv1 ee2 ee2':dexp),
     DValue vv1 ->
     DunfieldStep ee2 ee2' ->
     DunfieldStep (de_merge vv1 ee2) (de_merge vv1 ee2')
 | DStep_split : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee ->
     DunfieldStep ee (de_merge ee ee)
 | DStep_top : forall (ee:dexp),
     lc_dexp ee ->
     DunfieldStep ee de_top
 | DStep_toparr :
     DunfieldStep de_top (de_abs de_top).

Inductive icfpDisjoint : typ -> typ -> Prop :=

     icfpDisjoint A1 B ->
     icfpDisjoint A2 B ->
     icfpDisjoint (t_and A1 A2) B

     icfpDisjoint A B1 ->
     icfpDisjoint A B2 ->
     icfpDisjoint A (t_and B1 B2)
 | ID_ArrArr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     icfpDisjoint A2 B2 ->
     icfpDisjoint (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)

     icfpDisjointAx A B ->
     icfpDisjoint A B

 | IDax_IntArr : forall (A B:typ),
      not ( topLike B )  ->
     icfpDisjointAx t_int (t_arrow A B)
 | IDax_symm : forall (B A:typ),
     icfpDisjointAx A B ->
     icfpDisjointAx B A.

 | Wf_int : forall (G:ctx),
     WF G t_int
 | Wf_top : forall (G:ctx),
     WF G t_top
 | Wf_arr : forall (G:ctx) (A B:typ),
     WF G A ->
     WF G B ->
     WF G (t_arrow A B)
 | Wf_and : forall (G:ctx) (A B:typ),
     WF G A ->
     WF G B ->
     icfpDisjoint A B ->
     WF G (t_and A B).

Inductive isub : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | IS_z :
     isub t_int t_int
 | IS_top : forall (A:typ),
     isub A t_top
 | IS_arr : forall (A1 A2 B1 B2:typ),
     isub B1 A1 ->
     isub A2 B2 ->
     isub (t_arrow A1 A2) (t_arrow B1 B2)
 | IS_andl1 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     isub A1 A3 ->
     isub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | IS_andl2 : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     isub A2 A3 ->
     isub (t_and A1 A2) A3
 | IS_andr : forall (A1 A2 A3:typ),
     isub A1 A2 ->
     isub A1 A3 ->
     isub A1 (t_and A2 A3).

Inductive ITyping : ctx -> dexp -> typ -> exp -> Prop :=
 | ITyp_top : forall (G:ctx),
      uniq  G  ->
     ITyping G de_top t_top e_top
 | ITyp_lit : forall (G:ctx) (i5:i),
      uniq  G  ->
     ITyping G (de_lit i5) t_int (e_lit i5)
 | ITyp_var : forall (G:ctx) (x:var) (A:typ),
      uniq  G  ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     ITyping G (de_var_f x) A (e_var_f x)
 | ITyp_lam : forall (L:vars) (G:ctx) (ee:dexp) (A B:typ) (e:exp),
     WF G A ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> ITyping  (cons ( x , A )  G )   ( open_dexp_wrt_dexp ee (de_var_f x) )  B  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     ITyping G  ( (de_abs ee) )  (t_arrow A B)  ( (e_abs A e B) )
 | ITyp_app : forall (G:ctx) (ee1 ee2:dexp) (B:typ) (e1 e2:exp) (A:typ),
     ITyping G ee1 (t_arrow A B) e1 ->
     ITyping G ee2 A e2 ->
     ITyping G (de_app ee1 ee2) B (e_app e1 e2)
 | ITyp_merge : forall (G:ctx) (ee1 ee2:dexp) (A B:typ) (e1 e2:exp),
     ITyping G ee1 A e1 ->
     ITyping G ee2 B e2 ->
     icfpDisjoint A B ->
     ITyping G (de_merge ee1 ee2) (t_and A B) (e_merge e1 e2)
 | ITyp_sub : forall (G:ctx) (ee:dexp) (B:typ) (e:exp) (A:typ),
     ITyping G ee A e ->
     isub A B ->
     ITyping G ee B (e_anno e B).

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott rules_inf Infrastructure rules_inf2.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Fixpoint erase_anno (e:exp) : dexp :=
  match e with
  | (e_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | e_top => de_top
  | (e_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => de_abs (erase_anno e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => de_fixpoint (erase_anno e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => de_app (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => de_merge (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => erase_anno e
  end.

Notation "| e |" := (erase_anno e) (at level 30, e at level 39).

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary lemmas about erasure.                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Erasure commutes with opening. *)
Lemma erase_open_rec : forall k (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k r t) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k (erase_anno r) (erase_anno t).
Proof.
  intros k t. revert k. induction t as
    [ n | x | | i5 | A e B IHe | e A IHe | e1 e2 IHe1 IHe2
    | e1 e2 IHe1 IHe2 | e A IHe ]; intros k r; simpl.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - apply IHe.
Qed.

Lemma erase_open : forall (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp t r) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp (erase_anno t) (erase_anno r).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_exp_wrt_exp, open_dexp_wrt_dexp.
  apply erase_open_rec.
Qed.

(* Locally closed expressions erase to locally closed de Bruijn terms. *)
Lemma lc_exp_erase : forall e, lc_exp e -> lc_dexp (erase_anno e).
Proof.
  intros e H. induction H as
    [ x | | i5 | A e B Hbody IHbody | e A Hbody IHbody
    | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e A H IH ]; simpl.
  - apply lc_de_var_f.
  - apply lc_de_top.
  - apply lc_de_lit.
  - apply lc_de_abs. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_fixpoint. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_app; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_merge; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_anno; assumption.
Qed.

(* Changing the result annotation of an abstraction preserves local closure. *)
Lemma lc_exp_abs_anno : forall A e B D,
  lc_exp (e_abs A e B) -> lc_exp (e_abs A e D).
Proof.
  intros A e B D H. inversion H; subst. apply lc_e_abs. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_exp_topabs : forall B, lc_exp (e_abs t_top e_top B).
Proof.
  intro B. apply lc_e_abs. intro x. simpl. apply lc_e_top.
Qed.

(* Values erase to Dunfield values. *)
Lemma value_erase : forall v, value v -> DValue (erase_anno v).
Proof.
  intros v H. induction H as
    [ | i5 | A e B Hlc | v1 v2 Hv1 IH1 Hv2 IH2 ].
  - apply DVal_top.
  - apply DVal_nat.
  - apply DVal_abs. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
  - apply DVal_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction preserves valuehood. *)
Lemma value_typedreduce : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> value v -> value v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - apply value_lit.
  - apply value_unit.
  - apply value_anno. apply lc_exp_topabs.
  - apply value_anno. eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply value_merge; [ apply IH1; assumption | apply IH2; assumption ].
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction relates locally closed expressions. *)
Lemma typedreduce_lc : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> lc_exp v /\ lc_exp v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ].

  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_e_top ].
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_exp_topabs ].
  - split.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH1 as [Hv H1], IH2 as [Hv2 H2]. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Star lemmas for the Dunfield reduction.                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma mul_dstep_trans : forall a b c : dexp,
  (a ->>* b) -> (b ->>* c) -> (a ->>* c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. induction H as
    [ a | a b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros Hbc.
  - apply Hbc.
  - eapply star_step. apply Hstep. apply IH. apply Hbc.
Qed.

Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main simulation lemma for type-directed reduction.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma typedreduce_erase : forall v A v',
  value v -> TypedReduce v A v' -> (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v').
Proof.
  intros v A v' Hv H. revert Hv. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_toparr.
      * apply star_refl.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v1 A v1' Hderiv) as [Hlcv1 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmergel.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc2.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv1.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v2 A v2' Hderiv) as [Hlcv2 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmerger.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc1.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv2.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    assert (Hvv1 : value v1) by (inversion Hv; subst; assumption).
    assert (Hvv2 : value v2) by (inversion Hv; subst; assumption).
    assert (Hlcv : lc_exp v) by (apply (proj1 (typedreduce_lc v A v1 Hderiv1))).
    assert (Hlcdv : lc_dexp (erase_anno v)) by (apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlcv).
    assert (Hdv1 : DValue (erase_anno v1)) by (apply value_erase; apply Hvv1).
    assert (Hstar1 : (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v1)) by (apply IH1; apply Hv).
    assert (Hstar2 : (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v2)) by (apply IH2; apply Hv).
    eapply mul_dstep_trans.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_split. apply Hlcdv.
      * eapply mul_dstep_mergel.
        -- apply Hlcdv.
        -- apply Hstar1.
    + eapply mul_dstep_merger.
      * apply Hdv1.
      * apply Hstar2.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main theorem.                                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem reduction_soundness : forall e e',
    step e e' -> (erase_anno e) ->>* (erase_anno e').
Proof.
  intros e e' H. induction H as
    [ A e D v v' Hlc Hval Hred
    | v A v' Hval Hred
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH
    | e A e' Hstep IH
    | e A Hlc ].
  - (* Step_beta *)
    simpl. rewrite erase_open.
    pose proof (typedreduce_erase v A v' Hval Hred) as Hstar.
    pose proof (value_typedreduce v A v' Hred Hval) as Hval'.
    pose proof (DVal_abs (erase_anno e) (lc_exp_erase (e_abs A e D) Hlc)) as Hdabs.
    pose proof (star_appr (de_abs (erase_anno e)) (erase_anno v) (erase_anno v')
                  Hdabs Hstar) as Happ.
    pose proof (value_erase v' Hval') as Hdv'.
    eapply mul_dstep_trans.
    + apply Happ.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_beta.
        -- apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
        -- apply Hdv'.
      * apply star_refl.
  - (* Step_annov *)
    simpl. eapply typedreduce_erase; eassumption.
  - (* Step_appl *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_appl; [ apply IH | apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlc ].
  - (* Step_appr *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_appr.
    + apply value_erase. apply Hval.
    + apply IH.
  - (* Step_mergel *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_mergel; [ apply IH | apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlc ].
  - (* Step_merger *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_merger.
    + apply value_erase. apply Hval.
    + apply IH.
  - (* Step_anno *)
    simpl. apply IH.
  - (* Step_fix *)
    simpl. rewrite erase_open. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_fix. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott rules_inf Infrastructure rules_inf2.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Fixpoint erase_anno (e:exp) : dexp :=
  match e with
  | (e_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | e_top => de_top
  | (e_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => de_abs (erase_anno e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => de_fixpoint (erase_anno e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => de_app (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => de_merge (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => erase_anno e
  end.

  intros k t. revert k. induction t as
    [ n | x | | i5 | A e B IHe | e A IHe | e1 e2 IHe1 IHe2
    | e1 e2 IHe1 IHe2 | e A IHe ]; intros k r; simpl.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - apply IHe.
Qed.

  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp t r) =

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott rules_inf Infrastructure rules_inf2.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Fixpoint erase_anno (e:exp) : dexp :=
  match e with
  | (e_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | e_top => de_top
  | (e_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => de_abs (erase_anno e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => de_fixpoint (erase_anno e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => de_app (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => de_merge (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => erase_anno e
  end.

Notation "| e |" := (erase_anno e) (at level 30, e at level 39).

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary lemmas about erasure.                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Erasure commutes with opening. *)
Lemma erase_open_rec : forall k (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k r t) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k (erase_anno r) (erase_anno t).
Proof.
  intros k t. revert k. induction t as
    [ n | x | | i5 | A e B IHe | e A IHe | e1 e2 IHe1 IHe2
    | e1 e2 IHe1 IHe2 | e A IHe ]; intros k r; simpl.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - apply IHe.
Qed.

Lemma erase_open : forall (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp t r) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp (erase_anno t) (erase_anno r).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_exp_wrt_exp, open_dexp_wrt_dexp.
  apply erase_open_rec.
Qed.

(* Locally closed expressions erase to locally closed de Bruijn terms. *)
Lemma lc_exp_erase : forall e, lc_exp e -> lc_dexp (erase_anno e).
Proof.
  intros e H. induction H as
    [ x | | i5 | A e B Hbody IHbody | e A Hbody IHbody
    | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e A H IH ]; simpl.
  - apply lc_de_var_f.
  - apply lc_de_top.
  - apply lc_de_lit.
  - apply lc_de_abs. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_fixpoint. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_app; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_merge; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_anno; assumption.
Qed.

(* Changing the result annotation of an abstraction preserves local closure. *)
Lemma lc_exp_abs_anno : forall A e B D,
  lc_exp (e_abs A e B) -> lc_exp (e_abs A e D).
Proof.
  intros A e B D H. inversion H; subst. apply lc_e_abs. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_exp_topabs : forall B, lc_exp (e_abs t_top e_top B).
Proof.
  intro B. apply lc_e_abs. intro x. simpl. apply lc_e_top.
Qed.

(* Values erase to Dunfield values. *)
Lemma value_erase : forall v, value v -> DValue (erase_anno v).
Proof.
  intros v H. induction H as
    [ | i5 | A e B Hlc | v1 v2 Hv1 IH1 Hv2 IH2 ].
  - apply DVal_top.
  - apply DVal_nat.
  - apply DVal_abs. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
  - apply DVal_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction preserves valuehood. *)
Lemma value_typedreduce : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> value v -> value v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - apply value_lit.
  - apply value_unit.
  - apply value_anno. apply lc_exp_topabs.
  - apply value_anno. eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply value_merge; [ apply IH1; assumption | apply IH2; assumption ].
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction relates locally closed expressions. *)
Lemma typedreduce_lc : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> lc_exp v /\ lc_exp v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply lc_e_lit.
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_e_top ].
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_exp_topabs ].
  - split.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH1 as [Hv H1], IH2 as [Hv2 H2]. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Star lemmas for the Dunfield reduction.                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma mul_dstep_trans : forall a b c : dexp,
  (a ->>* b) -> (b ->>* c) -> (a ->>* c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. induction H as
    [ a | a b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros Hbc.
  - apply Hbc.
  - eapply star_step. apply Hstep. apply IH. apply Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_appl : forall e1 e1' : dexp,
  (e1 ->>* e1') ->
  forall e2, lc_dexp e2 -> (de_app e1 e2) ->>* (de_app e1' e2).
Proof.
  intros e1 e1' H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros e2 Hlc.
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_appl; [ apply Hlc | apply Hstep ].
    apply IH. apply Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_appr : forall (v1 : dexp) e2 e2',
  DValue v1 -> (e2 ->>* e2') -> (de_app v1 e2) ->>* (de_app v1 e2').
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 e2' Hv H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ].
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_appr; [ apply Hv | apply Hstep ]. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_mergel : forall e1 e1' : dexp,
  (e1 ->>* e1') ->
  forall e2, lc_dexp e2 -> (de_merge e1 e2) ->>* (de_merge e1' e2).
Proof.
  intros e1 e1' H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros e2 Hlc.
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_mergel; [ apply Hlc | apply Hstep ].
    apply IH. apply Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_merger : forall (v1 : dexp) e2 e2',
  DValue v1 -> (e2 ->>* e2') -> (de_merge v1 e2) ->>* (de_merge v1 e2').
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 e2' Hv H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ].
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_merger; [ apply Hv | apply Hstep ]. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main simulation lemma for type-directed reduction.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma typedreduce_erase : forall v A v',
  value v -> TypedReduce v A v' -> (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v').
Proof.
  intros v A v' Hv H. revert Hv. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_toparr.
      * apply star_refl.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v1 A v1' Hderiv) as [Hlcv1 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmergel.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc2.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv1.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v2 A v2' Hderiv) as [Hlcv2 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmerger.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc1.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv2.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    assert (Hvv1 : value v1) by (inversion Hv; subst; assumption).
    assert (Hvv2 : value v2) by (inversion Hv; subst; assumption).
    assert (Hlcv : lc_exp v) by (apply (proj1 (typedreduce_lc v A v1 Hderiv1))).
    assert (Hlcdv : lc_dexp (erase_anno v)) by (apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlcv).
    assert (Hdv1 : DValue (erase_anno v1)) by (apply value_erase; apply Hvv1).
    assert (Hstar1 : (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v1)) by (apply IH1; apply Hv).
    assert (Hstar2 : (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v2)) by (apply IH2; apply Hv).
    eapply mul_dstep_trans.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_split. apply Hlcdv.
      * eapply mul_dstep_mergel.
        -- apply Hlcdv.
        -- apply Hstar1.
    + eapply mul_dstep_merger.
      * apply Hdv1.
      * apply Hstar2.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main theorem.                                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem reduction_soundness : forall e e',
    step e e' -> (erase_anno e) ->>* (erase_anno e').
Proof.
  intros e e' H. induction H as
    [ A e D v v' Hlc Hval Hred
    | v A v' Hval Hred
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH
    | e A e' Hstep IH
    | e A Hlc ].
  - (* Step_beta *)
    simpl. rewrite erase_open.
    pose proof (typedreduce_erase v A v' Hval Hred) as Hstar.
    pose proof (value_typedreduce v A v' Hred Hval) as Hval'.
    pose proof (DVal_abs (erase_anno e) (lc_exp_erase (e_abs A e D) Hlc)) as Hdabs.
    pose proof (star_appr (de_abs (erase_anno e)) (erase_anno v) (erase_anno v')
                  Hdabs Hstar) as Happ.
    pose proof (value_erase v' Hval') as Hdv'.
    eapply mul_dstep_trans.
    + apply Happ.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_beta.
        -- apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
        -- apply Hdv'.
      * apply star_refl.
  - (* Step_annov *)
    simpl. eapply typedreduce_erase; eassumption.
  - (* Step_appl *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_appl; [ apply IH | apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlc ].
  - (* Step_appr *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_appr.
    + apply value_erase. apply Hval.
    + apply IH.
  - (* Step_mergel *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_mergel; [ apply IH | apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlc ].
  - (* Step_merger *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_merger.
    + apply value_erase. apply Hval.
    + apply IH.
  - (* Step_anno *)
    simpl. apply IH.
  - (* Step_fix *)
    simpl. rewrite erase_open. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_fix. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
Qed.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott rules_inf Infrastructure rules_inf2.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Fixpoint erase_anno (e:exp) : dexp :=
  match e with
  | (e_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | e_top => de_top
  | (e_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => de_abs (erase_anno e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => de_fixpoint (erase_anno e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => de_app (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => de_merge (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => erase_anno e
  end.

Notation "| e |" := (erase_anno e) (at level 30, e at level 39).

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary lemmas about erasure.                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Erasure commutes with opening. *)
Lemma erase_open_rec : forall k (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k r t) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k (erase_anno r) (erase_anno t).
Proof.
  intros k t. revert k. induction t as
    [ n | x | | i5 | A e IHe B | e IHe A | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2
    | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2 | e IHe A ]; intros k r; simpl.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - apply IHe.
Qed.

Lemma erase_open : forall (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp t r) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp (erase_anno t) (erase_anno r).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_exp_wrt_exp, open_dexp_wrt_dexp.
  apply erase_open_rec.
Qed.

(* Locally closed expressions erase to locally closed de Bruijn terms. *)
Lemma lc_exp_erase : forall e, lc_exp e -> lc_dexp (erase_anno e).
Proof.
  intros e H. induction H as
    [ x | | i5 | A e B Hbody IHbody | e A Hbody IHbody
    | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e A H IH ]; simpl.
  - apply lc_de_var_f.
  - apply lc_de_top.
  - apply lc_de_lit.
  - apply lc_de_abs. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_fixpoint. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_app; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_merge; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_anno; assumption.
Qed.

(* Changing the result annotation of an abstraction preserves local closure. *)
Lemma lc_exp_abs_anno : forall A e B D,
  lc_exp (e_abs A e B) -> lc_exp (e_abs A e D).
Proof.
  intros A e B D H. inversion H; subst. apply lc_e_abs. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_exp_topabs : forall B, lc_exp (e_abs t_top e_top B).
Proof.
  intro B. apply lc_e_abs. intro x. simpl. apply lc_e_top.
Qed.

(* Values erase to Dunfield values. *)
Lemma value_erase : forall v, value v -> DValue (erase_anno v).
Proof.
  intros v H. induction H as
    [ | i5 | A e B Hlc | v1 v2 Hv1 IH1 Hv2 IH2 ].
  - apply DVal_top.
  - apply DVal_nat.
  - apply DVal_abs. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
  - apply DVal_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction preserves valuehood. *)
Lemma value_typedreduce : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> value v -> value v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - apply value_lit.
  - apply value_unit.
  - apply value_anno. apply lc_exp_topabs.
  - apply value_anno. eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply value_merge; [ apply IH1; assumption | apply IH2; assumption ].
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction relates locally closed expressions. *)
Lemma typedreduce_lc : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> lc_exp v /\ lc_exp v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply lc_e_lit.
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_e_top ].
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_exp_topabs ].
  - split.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH1 as [Hv H1], IH2 as [Hv2 H2]. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Star lemmas for the Dunfield reduction.                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma mul_dstep_trans : forall a b c : dexp,
  (a ->>* b) -> (b ->>* c) -> (a ->>* c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. induction H as
    [ a | a b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros Hbc.
  - apply Hbc.
  - eapply star_step. apply Hstep. apply IH. apply Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_appl : forall e1 e1' : dexp,
  (e1 ->>* e1') ->
  forall e2, lc_dexp e2 -> (de_app e1 e2) ->>* (de_app e1' e2).
Proof.
  intros e1 e1' H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros e2 Hlc.
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_appl; [ apply Hlc | apply Hstep ].
    apply IH. apply Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_appr : forall (v1 : dexp) e2 e2',
  DValue v1 -> (e2 ->>* e2') -> (de_app v1 e2) ->>* (de_app v1 e2').
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 e2' Hv H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ].
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_appr; [ apply Hv | apply Hstep ]. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_mergel : forall e1 e1' : dexp,
  (e1 ->>* e1') ->
  forall e2, lc_dexp e2 -> (de_merge e1 e2) ->>* (de_merge e1' e2).
Proof.
  intros e1 e1' H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros e2 Hlc.
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_mergel; [ apply Hlc | apply Hstep ].
    apply IH. apply Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_merger : forall (v1 : dexp) e2 e2',
  DValue v1 -> (e2 ->>* e2') -> (de_merge v1 e2) ->>* (de_merge v1 e2').
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 e2' Hv H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ].
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_merger; [ apply Hv | apply Hstep ]. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main simulation lemma for type-directed reduction.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma typedreduce_erase : forall v A v',
  value v -> TypedReduce v A v' -> (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v').
Proof.
  intros v A v' Hv H. revert Hv. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_toparr.
      * apply star_refl.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v1 A v1' Hderiv) as [Hlcv1 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmergel.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc2.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv1.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v2 A v2' Hderiv) as [Hlcv2 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmerger.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc1.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv2.

(* Main theorem.                                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem reduction_soundness : forall e e',
    step e e' -> (erase_anno e) ->>* (erase_anno e').
Proof.

    [ A e D v v' Hlc Hval Hred
    | v A v' Hval Hred
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH

    + apply star_refl.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import syntax_ott rules_inf Infrastructure rules_inf2.

Require Import Coq.Strings.String.

Fixpoint erase_anno (e:exp) : dexp :=
  match e with
  | (e_var_b nat) => de_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => de_var_f x
  | e_top => de_top
  | (e_lit i5) => de_lit i5
  | (e_abs A e B) => de_abs (erase_anno e)
  | (e_fixpoint e A) => de_fixpoint (erase_anno e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => de_app (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_merge e1 e2) => de_merge (erase_anno e1) (erase_anno e2)
  | (e_anno e A) => erase_anno e
  end.

Notation "| e |" := (erase_anno e) (at level 30, e at level 39).

From Stdlib Require Import Lia.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Auxiliary lemmas about erasure.                                     *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

(* Erasure commutes with opening. *)
Lemma erase_open_rec : forall k (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k r t) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp_rec k (erase_anno r) (erase_anno t).
Proof.
  intros k t. revert k. induction t as
    [ n | x | | i5 | A e IHe B | e IHe A | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2
    | e1 IHe1 e2 IHe2 | e IHe A ]; intros k r; simpl.
  - destruct (lt_eq_lt_dec n k) as [[h|h]|h]; reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - rewrite IHe1, IHe2. reflexivity.
  - apply IHe.
Qed.

Lemma erase_open : forall (t r : exp),
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp t r) =
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp (erase_anno t) (erase_anno r).
Proof.
  intros. unfold open_exp_wrt_exp, open_dexp_wrt_dexp.
  apply erase_open_rec.
Qed.

Lemma erase_open_var : forall (t : exp) x,
  open_dexp_wrt_dexp (erase_anno t) (de_var_f x) =
  erase_anno (open_exp_wrt_exp t (e_var_f x)).
Proof.
  intros. rewrite erase_open. reflexivity.
Qed.

(* Locally closed expressions erase to locally closed de Bruijn terms. *)
Lemma lc_exp_erase : forall e, lc_exp e -> lc_dexp (erase_anno e).
Proof.
  intros e H. induction H as
    [ x | | i5 | A e B Hbody IHbody | e A Hbody IHbody
    | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e1 e2 H1 IH1 H2 IH2 | e A H IH ]; simpl.
  - apply lc_de_var_f.
  - apply lc_de_top.
  - apply lc_de_lit.
  - apply lc_de_abs. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_fixpoint. intro x. rewrite <- erase_open. apply IHbody. apply Hbody.
  - apply lc_de_app; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_merge; assumption.
  - apply lc_de_anno; assumption.
Qed.

(* Changing the result annotation of an abstraction preserves local closure. *)
Lemma lc_exp_abs_anno : forall A e B D,
  lc_exp (e_abs A e B) -> lc_exp (e_abs A e D).
Proof.
  intros A e B D H. inversion H; subst. apply lc_e_abs. assumption.
Qed.

Lemma lc_exp_topabs : forall B, lc_exp (e_abs t_top e_top B).
Proof.
  intro B. apply lc_e_abs. intro x. simpl. apply lc_e_top.
Qed.

(* Values erase to Dunfield values. *)
Lemma value_erase : forall v, value v -> DValue (erase_anno v).
Proof.
  intros v H. induction H as
    [ | i5 | A e B Hlc | v1 v2 Hv1 IH1 Hv2 IH2 ].
  - apply DVal_top.
  - apply DVal_nat.
  - apply DVal_abs. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
  - apply DVal_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction preserves valuehood. *)
Lemma value_typedreduce : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> value v -> value v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - apply value_lit.
  - apply value_unit.
  - apply value_anno. apply lc_exp_topabs.
  - apply value_anno. eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - apply value_merge; [ apply IH1; assumption | apply IH2; assumption ].
Qed.

(* Type-directed reduction relates locally closed expressions. *)
Lemma typedreduce_lc : forall v A v',
  TypedReduce v A v' -> lc_exp v /\ lc_exp v'.
Proof.
  intros v A v' H. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ].
  - split; apply lc_e_lit.
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_e_top ].
  - split; [ assumption | apply lc_exp_topabs ].
  - split.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
    + eapply lc_exp_abs_anno; eassumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH as [Hl Hr]. split.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
    + assumption.
  - destruct IH1 as [Hv H1], IH2 as [Hv2 H2]. split.
    + assumption.
    + apply lc_e_merge; assumption.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Star lemmas for the Dunfield reduction.                             *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma mul_dstep_trans : forall a b c : dexp,
  (a ->>* b) -> (b ->>* c) -> (a ->>* c).
Proof.
  intros a b c H. induction H as
    [ a | a b0 c0 Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros Hbc.
  - apply Hbc.
  - eapply star_step. apply Hstep. apply IH. apply Hbc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_appl : forall e1 e1' : dexp,
  (e1 ->>* e1') ->
  forall e2, lc_dexp e2 -> (de_app e1 e2) ->>* (de_app e1' e2).
Proof.
  intros e1 e1' H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros e2 Hlc.
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_appl; [ apply Hlc | apply Hstep ].
    apply IH. apply Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_appr : forall (v1 : dexp) e2 e2',
  DValue v1 -> (e2 ->>* e2') -> (de_app v1 e2) ->>* (de_app v1 e2').
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 e2' Hv H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ].
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_appr; [ apply Hv | apply Hstep ]. apply IH.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_mergel : forall e1 e1' : dexp,
  (e1 ->>* e1') ->
  forall e2, lc_dexp e2 -> (de_merge e1 e2) ->>* (de_merge e1' e2).
Proof.
  intros e1 e1' H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ]; intros e2 Hlc.
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_mergel; [ apply Hlc | apply Hstep ].
    apply IH. apply Hlc.
Qed.

Lemma mul_dstep_merger : forall (v1 : dexp) e2 e2',
  DValue v1 -> (e2 ->>* e2') -> (de_merge v1 e2) ->>* (de_merge v1 e2').
Proof.
  intros v1 e2 e2' Hv H. induction H as
    [ a | a b c Hstep Hrest IH ].
  - apply star_refl.
  - eapply star_step. apply DStep_merger; [ apply Hv | apply Hstep ]. apply IH.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main simulation lemma for type-directed reduction.                  *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Lemma typedreduce_erase : forall v A v',
  value v -> TypedReduce v A v' -> (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v').
Proof.
  intros v A v' Hv H. revert Hv. induction H as
    [ i5
    | v Hlc
    | v A B Hlc Htop
    | A e B C D Hlc Hnt Hs1 Hs2
    | v1 v2 A v1' Hlc2 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v1 v2 A v2' Hlc1 Hderiv IH Hord
    | v A B v1 v2 Hderiv1 IH1 Hderiv2 IH2 ]; intros Hv.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
  - simpl. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_top. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_toparr.
      * apply star_refl.
  - simpl. apply star_refl.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v1 A v1' Hderiv) as [Hlcv1 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmergel.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc2.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv1.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    destruct (typedreduce_lc v2 A v2' Hderiv) as [Hlcv2 _].
    eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_unmerger.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc1.
      * apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlcv2.
    + apply IH. inversion Hv; subst; assumption.
  - simpl.
    assert (Hvv1 : value v1) by (inversion Hv; subst; assumption).
    assert (Hvv2 : value v2) by (inversion Hv; subst; assumption).
    assert (Hlcv : lc_exp v) by (apply (proj1 (typedreduce_lc v A v1 Hderiv1))).
    assert (Hlcdv : lc_dexp (erase_anno v)) by (apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlcv).
    assert (Hdv1 : DValue (erase_anno v1)) by (apply value_erase; apply Hvv1).
    assert (Hstar1 : (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v1)) by (apply IH1; apply Hv).
    assert (Hstar2 : (erase_anno v) ->>* (erase_anno v2)) by (apply IH2; apply Hv).
    eapply mul_dstep_trans.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_split. apply Hlcdv.
      * eapply mul_dstep_mergel.
        -- apply Hlcdv.
        -- apply Hstar1.
    + eapply mul_dstep_merger.
      * apply Hdv1.
      * apply Hstar2.
Qed.

(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)
(* Main theorem.                                                       *)
(* ------------------------------------------------------------------ *)

Theorem reduction_soundness : forall e e',
    step e e' -> (erase_anno e) ->>* (erase_anno e').
Proof.
  intros e e' H. induction H as
    [ A e D v v' Hlc Hval Hred
    | v A v' Hval Hred
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH
    | e1 e2 e1' Hlc Hstep IH
    | v1 e2 e2' Hval Hstep IH
    | e A e' Hstep IH
    | e A Hlc ].
  - (* Step_beta *)
    simpl. rewrite erase_open.
    pose proof (typedreduce_erase v A v' Hval Hred) as Hstar.
    pose proof (value_typedreduce v A v' Hred Hval) as Hval'.
    pose proof (DVal_abs (erase_anno e) (lc_exp_erase (e_abs A e D) Hlc)) as Hdabs.
    pose proof (star_appr (de_abs (erase_anno e)) (erase_anno v) (erase_anno v')
                  Hdabs Hstar) as Happ.
    pose proof (value_erase v' Hval') as Hdv'.
    eapply mul_dstep_trans.
    + apply Happ.
    + eapply star_step.
      * apply DStep_beta.
        -- apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
        -- apply Hdv'.
      * apply star_refl.
  - (* Step_annov *)
    simpl. eapply typedreduce_erase; eassumption.
  - (* Step_appl *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_appl; [ apply IH | apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlc ].
  - (* Step_appr *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_appr.
    + apply value_erase. apply Hval.
    + apply IH.
  - (* Step_mergel *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_mergel; [ apply IH | apply lc_exp_erase; apply Hlc ].
  - (* Step_merger *)
    simpl. eapply mul_dstep_merger.
    + apply value_erase. apply Hval.
    + apply IH.
  - (* Step_anno *)
    simpl. apply IH.
  - (* Step_fix *)
    simpl. rewrite erase_open. eapply star_step.
    + apply DStep_fix. apply lc_exp_erase. apply Hlc.
    + apply star_refl.
Qed.
